summary: FSTEC 2026 contacts met by Todd Vahlsing on September 23-25, 2026. This is not a registration roster and not the Genius User Conference campaign. Contacts: Jason Ross — H-E-B; Jose Merino — Pollo Campero USA; Roberto Morado Jr — Pollo Campero; Lucie Tuan — Wingstop Inc; Rich McDonald — Glory Global; Todd Stewart — A&W Restaurants; Weston Huggins — CEC Entertainment; Daniel Legh-Page — Torchy’s Tac

Glory was confirmed as the global leader in retail cash-recycling solutions by RBR Data Services, with 44% market share excluding Japan and 68% including Japan, per Glory's own press release. (Scope note: This finding is dated January 2025, the most recent dated market-share confirmation located; no newer 2026 RBR figure was found in this pass.)

For restaurants, Glory's back-office cash-recycling solutions track cash from the point-of-sale through the back office/cash room, and its CASHINFINITY closed-loop platform extends automation to self-checkout and multi-location back-office cash management.
Glory's CI-5 is a small-footprint cash recycler marketed specifically for the point-of-sale counter, extending its recycling technology below its larger back-office units.
